raw_context:
Farmasierra Distribución
is the logistics and contract warehousing subsidiary of the Spanish
Farmasierra Group
, providing national storage, inventory management, and transport solutions to pharmacies, hospitals, wholesalers, and third-party pharmaceutical laboratories.
Grupo Farmasierra
Core Operations & Scope
Service Recipients:
Farmacies, hospitals, and national pharmaceutical wholesalers.
Grupo Farmasierra
Managed Product Categories:
Prescription medicines, over-the-counter (OTC) non-prescription drugs, food supplements, health products, medical devices, special medical-use dietary foods, cosmetics, and promotional materials.
Grupo Farmasierra
Facility Specifications:
Operates out of an advanced logistics hub in Cabanillas del Campo (Guadalajara, Spain) featuring multi-temperature chambers (ambient 15ºC–25ºC, cold storage 2ºC–8ºC, and freezing -15ºC to -25ºC/-18 to -22ºC) alongside restricted-access psychotropic storage.
Grupo Farmasierra
